note: The pin Mitten has a state at 2010 and another at 2020 and misses 2015, where MittenAlt delivers. A list period 2010,2015,2020 reaches two Mitten states of one column and no value set, which the order emits as one entry, so no `binding_state_drifts_within_period` (#1899: a state boundary counts only where the folded column or value set changes). The clip itself is `order/clip-pinned-middle-segment`'s. Fails if drift counts the unpinned MittenAlt state the pin excludes, or counts a state boundary of an unchanged column across the missed segment.
